title: Khởi nghiệp kinh doanh nông nghiệp

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students understand agricultural business and startup concepts.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding business ideas and goals in agriculture
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students comprehend business ideas and goals within agricultural contexts.
Students learn how to conduct market research for agricultural businesses.
Students develop skills to create startup plans for agricultural ventures.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Enterprise creation and agricultural business operations
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students gain knowledge on creating enterprises and managing agricultural businesses.
Students learn strategies for managing risks in agricultural businesses.
Students improve their ability to self-study and conduct research.
Students develop skills for working collaboratively in teams.
Students develop critical thinking skills to analyze problems in agricultural startups.
